# Proj

A small tool. See [the guide](docs/guide.md) and [contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Install

```sh
cargo install --path .
```

Config lives in `~/.config/app/app.conf`; override with `--config /etc/app.conf`.

## Links

- Homepage: <https://example.com/proj>
- Issues: https://github.com/example/proj/issues?q=is%3Aopen
- Docs (https://docs.example.com/proj/latest).
- Mail <mailto:ann@example.com>

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `src/main.rs` | entry point |
| `src/lib.rs` | library |
| `Cargo.toml` | manifest |

> Note: see **README.md** and _docs/guide.md_ for more.

1. Edit `src/server/mod.rs`
2. Run `cargo test`
3. Open http://localhost:3000/ in a browser, or example.com/docs/intro

Version 1.2.3 released 2026/10/27. Commit 9c8d7e6 fixes it.
